<b>Splinters</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are members of the [[Splinter Tribe]] with sharp forearms and bulging eyes.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Splinters hide as background objects until Hornet gets close, at which point they shake and then pop out to begin their attack. Splinters are much more cautious than Splinterhorns.

Splinters frequently move backwards and forwards between attacks, and slash horizontally at Hornet once she is in range, rapidly hitting for {{Damage|1+1}}.

Splinters deal {{Damage|1}} upon contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Splinters have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2
|
* Hidey, hidey, here I lay!
* Monster, monster, run away!
* Brother, brother, time to play!
* Sister, sister, your dismay!
}}

== Location ==
Splinters can be found in [[Shellwood]]. Two can be found in the long room to the right of [[Shellwood]]'s rightmost bench.
